event.title: EV Battery Cybersecurity

event.description: Demonstration of the Battery Cybersecurity Platform, showcasing backend components, database integration, and the Cyber Attack Simulator. The demo will cover simulated cyberattacks, including telemetry spoofing, replay attacks, and Battery Management System (BMS) intrusion scenarios, along with the Detection Rule Simulator.
